strategies.name: Bandwidth sharing app (Honeygain / Pawns)
strategies.how: Leave an app running and it sells a sliver of your internet connection. Truly passive, but small.
strategies.watch: Strangers' traffic leaves from your home IP, and some ISPs forbid it. Read the terms first.

strategies.name: Refer friends to apps you already use
strategies.how: Most apps on this list (Fetch, Ibotta, Upside, Prolific) pay for referrals. Share only with people who'd want it.
strategies.watch: No spamming.

strategies.name: Fetch receipt scanning
strategies.how: Snap every HEB, Walmart, gas and restaurant receipt in the Fetch app for points, turned into gift cards. You already photograph receipts for Wolf Hall, so it's one extra snap.
strategies.watch: Gift cards, not cash. Points expire if inactive.

strategies.name: Upside gas cash back
strategies.how: Claim the offer in the app before pumping; cents per gallon back. Both of you buy gas weekly.
strategies.watch: Compare the real price; a cheaper station can beat the cash back.

strategies.name: Ibotta (Walmart and grocery cash back)
strategies.how: Link your Walmart account and add offers before shopping; cash back lands in Ibotta and cashes out to PayPal or bank.
strategies.watch: Only buy what you were already buying.

strategies.name: Rakuten / Capital One Shopping on online orders
strategies.how: Browser extension adds cash back to online orders you already place (Walmart delivery, pet supplies).
strategies.watch: Extensions see your shopping; keep it to one trusted one.

strategies.name: Microsoft Rewards daily set
strategies.how: You're already a member. Daily Bing searches, quizzes and the daily set earn points for gift cards. The Architect can remind you each morning.
strategies.watch: Do it by hand. Bots or scripts get accounts banned.

strategies.name: Google Opinion Rewards
strategies.how: Short phone surveys, 10 cents to $1 each, paid to PayPal.
strategies.watch: Answer honestly or surveys dry up.

strategies.name: Respondent paid interviews (strategist profile)
strategies.how: Companies pay $50-$200 for an hour-long interview with people in specific jobs. Your strategist background fits B2B studies. The Architect polishes your profile.
strategies.watch: Be truthful in screeners; they verify.

strategies.name: Prolific research studies
strategies.how: University and company research studies, usually $8-$15 an hour, paid to PayPal. The best-paying 'survey' site.
strategies.watch: One account, real answers. No AI doing the studies for you.

strategies.name: UserTesting / Userlytics website tests
strategies.how: Use a website or app while talking out loud, about $10 per 20-minute test.
strategies.watch: Tests come and go fast; quality ratings decide how many you get.

strategies.name: AI training work (DataAnnotation, Outlier)
strategies.how: Rate and write answers that train AI models, often $20+ an hour after passing a skills test.
strategies.watch: They ban using AI to do the work. This one is all you.

strategies.name: Texas unclaimed property search (whole household)
strategies.how: Search ClaimItTexas.gov (and any state you've lived in, plus MissingMoney.com) for Horace, Taylor and the kids. Old deposits, refunds and paychecks sit there until claimed. One-time, often $20-$500.
strategies.watch: Free to claim. Never pay a 'finder' service.

strategies.name: Class action settlements you qualify for
strategies.how: The Architect checks open settlements (products, apps, data breaches) against what's in your email and purchase history, and lists the ones you can honestly claim. You file the 2-minute form.
strategies.watch: Only claim ones you really qualify for. False claims are fraud.

strategies.name: Insurance refund on the repossessed EcoSport
strategies.how: If the EcoSport is still on the Allstate policy, removing it stops the premium and can refund the unused part. Also ask the lender about any GAP or warranty refunds after the repo.
strategies.watch: Dropped 10/25: Allstate only covered the truck, so there is no EcoSport premium to refund.

strategies.name: Lower monthly bills (negotiate or switch)
strategies.how: The Architect reviews T-Mobile, Starlink, insurance and subscriptions in Wolf Hall, finds cheaper plans or promos, and writes your call script. Money saved counts as money earned.
strategies.watch: Check contracts and fees before switching.

strategies.name: Bank sign-up bonus
strategies.how: Banks pay $100-$300 for opening a checking account with direct deposit. One-time per bank.
strategies.watch: Needs moving a paycheck and avoiding fees; don't let it complicate the Pool. Check with Horace before any account change.

strategies.name: Declutter: sell unused stuff on Facebook Marketplace
strategies.how: Photograph items; the Architect writes the listing and suggests a price from sold listings. Local cash, no shipping.
strategies.watch: Meet in public; cash or in-app payment only.

strategies.name: Trade in old phones, tablets and electronics
strategies.how: Old devices in drawers can be traded in (carrier, Best Buy, Gazelle) for cash or credit. One-time.
strategies.watch: Wipe the device and remove accounts first.

strategies.name: Sell unused gift cards
strategies.how: Cards you won't use sell for 70-90% of face value on CardCash-type sites.
strategies.watch: Use the card yourself if you'd buy there anyway.

strategies.name: Sell a 'Household Budget OS' Notion template
strategies.how: You've built a whole household money system. The Architect turns a clean, data-free version into a Notion template (Pool, bills, weekly budget, receipts) to sell on Gumroad and Etsy.
strategies.watch: Strip every real name and number first.

strategies.name: Printable planners on Etsy (budget, chores, pets)
strategies.how: The Architect designs PDF planners; you list them once and they sell repeatedly.
strategies.watch: Etsy charges $0.20 a listing; the market is crowded, so niche it down.

strategies.name: Freelance AI-assisted services on Fiverr
strategies.how: Sell what you've learned building Wolf Hall: Notion setups, budget spreadsheets, simple automations. The Architect drafts the work; you review and deliver.
strategies.watch: Be upfront that you use AI tools; deliver real quality or reviews sink you.
